# S10 — Write the starter bots and golden-result tests

Write original starter bots (an imp, a bomber named dwarf, a replicator, a scanner) and golden-result tests that pin their match outcomes.

**Findings:** PROJECT.md v1 features, Risks · **Size:** M · **Tree:** bots
Cites: C14 constraint: Do not bundle existing warriors until licensing is checked, C16 requirement: Same result and replay hash for pit run imp.s dwarf.s --seed 1, C18 requirement: Starter-bot tournament over 100 seeds prints a stable scoreboard, C26 decision: Name: pitfight, CLI command pit, C34 constraint: Go caches stay in the repo; local checks

**2026-10-15** — **2026-10-15** — From S03 review: isa.md §8 replicator sketch keeps one process (the original dies at cell 5); the starter replicator should loop back instead of DAT so it multiplies.

**Not in this slice:** bundling or adapting existing published warriors (C14; needs the licensing check and owner approval).

## Why

The starter set is the test and example set, the ISA balance test, and the inputs of acceptance criteria C16 (`pit run imp.s dwarf.s --seed 1`) and C18.

## Files

- `bots/imp.s`, `bots/dwarf.s`, `bots/replicator.s`, `bots/scanner.s` (new, original).
- `internal/arena/bots_test.go`: strategy tests reading `../../bots/*.s`.
- `internal/arena/golden_test.go`: a hand-reviewed table of golden results (winner, cycles run) per pairing and seed.

## Failing tests

- `TestStarterBotsAssemble`: each bot in `bots/` assembles and round-trips through `internal/asm`.
- `TestImp`: the imp alone survives to the cycle limit.
- `TestDwarf`: the bomber writes at its fixed stride (checked through write events).
- `TestReplicator`: the replicator spawns copies (spawn events and copied cells).
- `TestScanner`: the scanner finds and attacks an enemy placed at a known offset.
- `TestGolden`: every pairing of the four bots at seeds 1, 2 and 3 gives the pinned winner and cycles run.

## Implement

- Write each bot from scratch against the ISA spec.
- If the ISA cannot express a strategy, record a finding against the ISA spec instead of working around it.
- Golden values are reviewed by hand before they are pinned, not copied blindly from a first run.

## Check

- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `. scripts/env.sh && go run ./cmd/pit run bots/imp.s bots/dwarf.s --seed 1 > .cache/tmp/c16a.txt && go run ./cmd/pit run bots/imp.s bots/dwarf.s --seed 1 > .cache/tmp/c16b.txt && cmp .cache/tmp/c16a.txt .cache/tmp/c16b.txt` succeeds.
- The note on this item says how each golden value was reviewed by hand.

## Git

Branch `slice/<id>-starter-bots` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
